description: Rigid slide test with heavy-atom clash criterion, AcsD site vs BcsA translocation channel
code:
exec(open("_lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
AA=set('ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL MSE'.split())

def slide(lig, prot, direction, srange, helical=None):
    tr=cKDTree(prot); rows=[]
    for s in srange:
        if helical is None: Q=lig+direction*s
        else:
            r0,pitch=helical; dz=s*np.cos(np.radians(pitch)); dphi=s*np.sin(np.radians(pitch))/r0
            c_,s_=np.cos(dphi),np.sin(dphi); R=np.array([[c_,-s_,0],[s_,c_,0],[0,0,1.]])
            Q=lig@R.T+np.array([0,0,dz])
        d,_=tr.query(Q,k=20,workers=-1)
        rows.append(dict(s=round(float(s),2), min_d=round(float(d.min()),2),
                         n_lt24=int((d<2.4).sum()), n_lt26=int((d<2.6).sum()), n_lt30=int((d<3.0).sum())))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

B=framed("3A8E"); P8=B[B.resn!="BGC"]
prot=P8[["px","py","pz"]].values
lig=B[(B.resn=="BGC")&(B.uchain=="F_0")][["px","py","pz"]].values
cen=lig.mean(0); r0=float(np.hypot(*cen[:2]))
L=np.linalg.svd(lig-cen,full_matrices=False)[2][0]; L=L if L[2]>0 else -L
S=np.arange(-12,12.01,0.26)
a_lin=slide(lig,prot,L,S); a_hel=slide(lig,prot,None,S,helical=(r0,43.6))

df=parse_pdb("./4HG6.pdb"); pr=df[df.resn.isin(AA)]
cP=pr[["x","y","z"]].values
w=df[(df.resn=="BGC")&(df.resi.isin(range(11,16)))][["x","y","z"]].values
Lw=np.linalg.svd(w-w.mean(0),full_matrices=False)[2][0]
b_lin=slide(w,cP,Lw,S)
w2=df[(df.resn=="BGC")&(df.resi.isin(range(7,12)))][["x","y","z"]].values
Lw2=np.linalg.svd(w2-w2.mean(0),full_matrices=False)[2][0]
b_lin2=slide(w2,cP,Lw2,S)

def span(t, col="n_lt24", lim=0):
    s=t.set_index("s")[col]; lo=hi=0.0
    for v in sorted([x for x in s.index if x<=0])[::-1]:
        if s[v]<=lim: lo=v
        else: break
    for v in sorted([x for x in s.index if x>=0]):
        if s[v]<=lim: hi=v
        else: break
    return lo,hi
print("clash-free slide span (no heavy-atom pair < 2.4 A), around the crystallographic pose:")
for nm,t in [("AcsD F_0 linear",a_lin),("AcsD F_0 helical",a_hel),
             ("BcsA Glc11-15 (TM channel)",b_lin),("BcsA Glc7-11 (TM channel)",b_lin2)]:
    lo,hi=span(t); print(f"  {nm:30s} {lo:+.2f} .. {hi:+.2f} A  (width {hi-lo:5.2f} A); min_d at s=0 = {t.loc[t.s.abs().idxmin(),'min_d']:.2f} A")
print("\n  one glucose translocation step = 5.18 A; a sliding channel must allow at least this.")
pd.concat([a_lin.assign(case='AcsD_linear'),a_hel.assign(case='AcsD_helical'),
           b_lin.assign(case='BcsA_Glc11_15'),b_lin2.assign(case='BcsA_Glc7_11')]).to_csv("slide_profiles.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.6,4.3))
for t,c,ls,lb in [(a_lin,"#dd6b20","-","AcsD 3A8E site, straight slide"),
                  (a_hel,"#9c4221","--","AcsD 3A8E site, helical slide (43 deg)"),
                  (b_lin,"#2b6cb0","-","BcsA 4HG6 channel, Glc11-15"),
                  (b_lin2,"#63b3ed","--","BcsA 4HG6 channel, Glc7-11")]:
    ax.plot(t.s,t.min_d,ls,color=c,label=lb,lw=1.6)
ax.axhline(2.4,color="k",ls=":",lw=.9); ax.text(-11.8,2.45,"hard clash limit 2.4 A",fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(-5.18,5.18,color="grey",alpha=.12)
ax.set_xlabel("rigid displacement of the glucan along the putative translocation path (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("closest glucan-protein heavy atom distance (A)")
ax.set_title("Sliding test: AcsD binding site versus the BcsA translocation channel\n(grey band = one glucose step either way)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
